newsitem.title: USA: Grove Real Estate Trust sets div.
newsitem.headline: Grove Real Estate Trust sets div.

text.p: Grove Real Estate Trust said it set a short dividend of $0.1763 per share for the period January 1 through March 10, 1997, subject to the closing of a restructuring on March 11.

On February 14, the company announced its restructuring by consolidating properties into a new real estate investment trust to be called Grove Property Trust. The company also declared a five percent stock dividend and concurrent stock split of 1.125 to 1, subject to the closing of the restructuring on March 11.
The prior dividend was a regular quarterly dividend of $0.23 per share.
The short dividend, the five percent stock dividend and the stock split will be paid March 28 to shareholders of record on March 10.
